Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

people.name: David

people.name: Hiram
people.line: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, “As you dealt with David my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, so deal with me.
translations.bsb: Then Solomon sent word to Hiram king of Tyre: “Do for me as you did for my father David when you sent him cedars to build himself a house to live in.
translations.kjv: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
translations.asv: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him a house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
